newsitem.title: GERMANY: Alcatel insurance programme causes consternation.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel insurance programme causes consternation.

text.p: The latest insurance arrangements made by French industrial group Alcatel, with close involvement from reinsurers Swiss Re and Scor, have caused consternation among primary insurers, according to market sources in France and Germany.
The primary insurers fear that the agreement marks a further erosion of their role because reinsurers are negotiating directly with industrial customers.

Alcatel is insuring property, liability and CAR/EAR risks with a consortium of French primary insurers including UAP, AGF and Axa. Existing primary insurance arrangements with these companies are continuing.

However, major changes have been introduced on the reinsurance side. The primary companies cede some 90 percent of the business to Alcatel's captive reinsurer, Electro Re, which now bundles reinsurance of all the different lines.
The captive, in turn, is passing most of the business on to professional reinsurers and to primary companies acting as reinsurers.

Swiss Re and Scor are leading the programme. According to the market sources, Scor is taking some 16 percent of the risk, Swiss Re around 20 percent. Munich Re has a share of "less than 10 percent", they said.
Similar shares have been taken by primary insurers, again including UAP, AGF and Axa. None of the reinsurance companies was prepared to comment.

The programme covers three years and is believed to carry a premium volume of more than 400 million French Francs. The loss limit of the programme is estimated at French Francs600 million. --Reuters Insurance News +49 221 51 2007
